_README: Cells where a filtered arm is expected to barely move, declared in advance so
the immobilised_prevention gate can tell a deliberate stationary control from
a prevention claim that quietly rests on the vehicle never setting off.
A declaration is not an excuse. It asserts that the immobilisation is the
point of the cell and that no prevention count in the manuscript pools it in.
Anything not listed here still fails the build, which is what caught the
2026-07-28 convoy study in the first place.
Keys are result directory names. Each entry lists the scenarios exempted for
that source, with the reason and where the reason is written down.

reason: Preregistered stationary negative control. DOB-CBF's delay term is
d_delay = v * min(2*tau, 0.6), proportional to speed, so it vanishes at
rest. lead_brake is included precisely because the ego halts there: it is
the cell where the mechanism under test must show no effect, and it does
(paired delta +0.003 m, p = 0.0625). Excluding it from the primary
endpoint was fixed before the contrast was observed.
Same preregistered stationary negative control as the 2026-07-30
generation: DOB-CBF's delay term d_delay = v * min(2*tau, 0.6)
vanishes at rest, so lead_brake is the cell where the mechanism under
test must show no effect. The 2026-08-01 regeneration under contract
v4 and the static controller surrogate reproduces the identical
stationary outcome (median progress 0.1 m in both filtered arms).
Excluded from every prevention count in the manuscript.
